xml.name: Parking Available
xml.description: A parking availability calendar application. Owners can mark parking availability, neighbors can view it. French interface with brutalist design.
xml.overview:
Parking Available - Parking Availability Calendar
A calendar application for managing parking spot availability in your neighborhood.
FEATURES: • Visual calendar showing availability status • Three status types: Available (green), Partial (orange dashed), Unavailable (black) • Public access - anyone can view the calendar • Owner mode - authenticated users can set availability • French interface with bold brutalist design • SQLite database - no external database required
DEFAULT USERS (created on first run): • admin / admin123 (owner) • jade / jade123 (owner) • bob / bob123 (neighbor)
PORTS: • Frontend: 80 (HTTP) - Main application • Backend: 8080 (API) - API endpoint
VOLUMES: • /mnt/user/appdata/parking-available: Database and app data
ACCESS: • Web UI: http://[IP]:[PORT:80] • API: http://[IP]:[PORT:8080]

param.name: Volume Path
param.description: Application data directory for SQLite database

param.name: JWT Secret
param.description: JWT secret key for authentication (change in production)
